motivation: The completed coarse 5-km structural holdout did not replace nearest-known and added only a small increment over spatial balance at 5 km. The next architecture separates regional exploration from fine localization instead of retuning opened structural recipes.

scope.local_lane_reason: nearest-known retains a strong local comparator/exploitation role and should not be displaced by this architecture

role_separation.fine_support_source: already frozen family-specific structural support machinery or a separately frozen future fine structural support generator

global_order.rule: rank fine candidates within each coarse cell by structural support; then order globally by within-cell structural rank first and coarse coverage rank second
global_order.equivalent_description: take the best fine candidate from every non-empty coarse cell in coverage order, then the second-best from every cell, then the third-best, continuing until all candidates are exhausted

why_rank_not_score_fusion.reason: Structural-support magnitudes can have family- and cell-specific calibration. Only within-cell structural rank is used, so broad coverage cannot be overwhelmed by an arbitrary absolute support scale.

minimum_comparators: same fine frame with deterministic spatial balance
coverage order with within-cell stable non-structural ordering

forbidden: do not fit a coverage/structure weight on the opened Cirsium holdout
do not pick coarse or fine resolution after seeing a fresh outcome
do not compare absolute structural scores across coarse cells in v1
do not merge LOCAL and DETACHED lanes into one fitted score
do not let roads, access, permissions, route cost, time or budget create ecological support
do not claim field efficiency or occupancy without prospective complete effort and detection/non-detection logs
